WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as distinct_orders 
  FROM Invoices i 
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id 
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id 
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_orders) as avg_orders FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.gender,
    s1.distinct_orders,
    s1.distinct_orders - s2.avg_orders as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.distinct_orders > s2.avg_orders
)
SELECT 
  AVG(distinct_orders) as avg_distinct_orders,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step3
